title: eSIM · Operación y trazabilidad
brief: Make the six existing operational capabilities easier to scan and more responsive to interaction while preserving the current dark-blue eSIM language and exact source sentences. Scope: section 04 only; no production implementation, new business promises, links, contact form or flow redesign. System-font previews, responsive to 320px, no external resources.

artboards.title: Recommended · Uniform capability cards
artboards.tradeoff: Editorial introduction on the left; six equally weighted cards in two columns on desktop and one on mobile. All information stays visible, with decorative hover feedback only and selected 8px card corners (Tailwind rounded-lg). Best scan consistency; takes more vertical room on mobile.

artboards.title: Alternative · Traceability-led bento
artboards.tradeoff: Wide editorial introduction above five compact capability tiles and a full-width final traceability card. Preserves source order and visible text; stronger final emphasis but less uniform scanning and an intentionally unequal hierarchy.

artboards.title: Alternative · Native disclosure accordion
artboards.tradeoff: Editorial introduction beside six native details/summary disclosures, first open and others independently expandable with keyboard or touch. Compact and genuinely interactive, but requires expansion to see every original sentence; no invented extra detail.
